# Rocket Llama Labs

> Marketing and technology for home service companies, based in Phoenix, Arizona. We build and run the whole marketing system for one company at a time: website, Google and AI search, Google Business Profile, ads, reviews, phones, AI receptionist and CRM. Every lead is answered in under a minute. Every dollar is tracked to a paid job. The client owns everything.

## Who we are

- Branson Cobb, CEO. 23 years leading sales, business development and client strategy for large healthcare organizations (CBIZ, Aetna, Cigna).
- Brian Greenberg, Chief Strategy Officer. Twenty-plus years building businesses that get found online; built a fully digital insurance agency to $50M+ in revenue through inbound marketing; author of The Salesman Who Doesn't Sell; Million Dollar Round Table member.
- Madison Schantz, Chief Marketing Officer. Branding, websites and AI-powered tools.

## Who we serve

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, garage door, pest control, landscaping, painting and every trade that goes to a customer's home. Phoenix and the Valley (Scottsdale, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Tempe, Peoria); other markets remotely.
